title: ForceActive - Weather
content:
Member of: Weather Script Forces the active weather on the sky to be this weather. Weather will become fully transitioned immediately. To have the weather transition in normally, use SetActive instead. Syntax: Function ForceActive(bool abOverride = false) native Parameters: - abOverride: If true, this weather remain active until released using ReleaseOverride. Default: False Return Value: None Examples: ; Force the good weather to be active GoodWeather.ForceActive()
; Force the windy weather to be active until released WindyWeather.ForceActive(true) Notes: - If you're setting a weather as you load in, be sure you call this AFTER the load is started, or else it'll get bashed. (for example: I move the player to a spot to start CharGen, make sure this call happens after the MoveTo and after a short Wait so it happens after the loadscreen starts). See Also: - Weather Script - SetActive - Weather
